definitions.explanation: A reduced price offered to students for transportation, admission, services, and products. Short for 学生割引. Very common in Japan for train tickets, museum admission, movie theaters, and more.

examples.japanese: {学割|がくわり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie at the student discount price.

examples.japanese: {学割|がくわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二割引|にわりびき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you use the student discount, the bullet train ticket is 20% off.

examples.japanese: {学割|がくわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生証|がくせいしょう}→学生証：14966_gakuseishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}→提示：12905_teiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: You need to show your student ID to apply for the student discount.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of {学生割引|がくせいわりびき} (student discount). The abbreviation {学割|がくわり} is far more common in everyday speech. Widely available in Japan for train tickets (especially long-distance JR), museums, movie theaters, and various services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学割|がくわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a student discount)
- {学割|がくわり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (the student discount applies)
- {学割|がくわり}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (student discount price)
- {学割|がくわり}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ (student discount certificate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: discount — the general word for any kind of discount
- {団体割引|だんたいわりびき}: group discount — a discount for group bookings
